column1: # The conjugation class of a lemma that stems.tsv does not list. The first matching row wins.
# stems.tsv is consulted first: a whole-lemma row, then the longest lemma suffix it lists
#   match   lemma=X: the lemma is X | suffix=X: the lemma ends in X | final=J: the stem's last
#           syllable has the final J (0 = none) | vowel=J: the stem's last vowel is J | syl=X: the
#   pos     V | A | X | * (the pos of the lemma)

column4: -적이다, 학생이다: a noun with the copula
모르다, 부르다, 빠르다 (따르다, 치르다, 들르다 are EU in stems.tsv)
쓰다, 크다, 바쁘다 (stem without a final)
덥다, 고맙다, 아름답다 (좁다, 수줍다 are REG in stems.tsv)
파랗다, 그렇다 (좋다 is REG in stems.tsv)
everything else (ㄷ ㅅ ㅂ verbs are regular unless stems.tsv lists them)
